tool-connection-diagnostics.title: Connection diagnostics
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.workspa: A local connection needs this project's workspace. Choose a workspace before continuing the connection.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.not_ins: This check did not find the tool. Review its installation instructions, then explicitly check the local installation.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.unsuppo: The local connector cannot start this entry. Review the tool's supported installation method, then check the installation.
tool-connection-diagnostics.reason.inval: Installation package could not be verified
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.invalid: The detected package did not pass verification. Check the installation against the tool's instructions, then explicitly detect it again.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.node_un: No usable Node.js runtime was found. Follow the tool's instructions to prepare the runtime, then check the installation.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.probe_f: The check did not produce a usable result. Review the configuration or explicitly check the local installation again.
tool-connection-diagnostics.reason.model: Model directory read did not complete
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.model_c: No valid model directory was returned. Review the current connection configuration; check the original operation's status first if its outcome is unresolved.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.configu: Fill in the configuration required by this connection before continuing. Saving configuration does not establish connection readiness.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.origina: The original operation has not been verified. Read its status and confirm the outcome before starting another check or connection.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.authori: Authorization needs checking. Use the current account and project to verify the original connection before continuing.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.binding: The current binding differs from the original connection. Check that connection's status before continuing with the current project workspace.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.origin_: The current service address differs from the original connection. Check that connection's status and keep the original operation record.
tool-connection-diagnostics.reason.crede: Original connection credentials could not be recovered
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.credent: Check the original connection's status first. Keep its original record until the operation's outcome is confirmed.
tool-connection-diagnostics.hint.unknown: There is not enough information to determine the next step. Review the current connection settings or ask an administrator to check the reason code.
